_about: A12 - housing profile definitions. Each profile selects one BAH cell (pay grade x dependency status from B4), the bedroom count used to pick benchmark series (SAFMR, optional ZHVI bedroom files), and the member cost-share dollars DoD deducts for that cell. Read by Layer 2 (F10, B12-B15) and shipped to Layer 3 inside B21 UI metadata. Validate with `make check-config`.
coverage_target_note: Nominal only. 37 U.S.C. 403(b)(3) sets BAH = local cost of adequate housing minus 5% of the NATIONAL average cost for the grade, so BAH covers exactly 95% only where local cost equals the national mean (more in expensive MHAs, less in cheap ones). B12-B15 test adequacy_ratio = (BAH + cost_share_monthly) / benchmark against 1.00; coverage_target is kept for the flat-95% sensitivity column (flat95_gap).

profiles.label: E-5 with dependents
profiles.rationale: Primary research profile. DoD's housing standard for E-5 is a 2-bedroom townhouse, so the anchor maps to a single bedroom count without interpolation.

profiles.label: O-3 with dependents
profiles.rationale: Contrast profile. DoD's O-3 standard sits 98% of the way from a 3-bedroom townhouse to a 3-bedroom single-family home, so it differs from the primary in grade band, bedroom count, and dwelling type at once.

benchmarks.zori_bedroom_note: ZORI has no bedroom breakdown: one ZIP-level series applies to every profile, adjusted to utilities-inclusive with B5. Bedroom-specific comparison comes from the SAFMR cross-check.

sources: DoD BAH housing standards by pay grade (BAH Primer; summarized at military.com/paycheck-chronicles/2014/12/04/much-house-rate)

cost_share._about: Member out-of-pocket (absorption) dollars per profile, read from DTMO's annual out-of-pocket table. Same amount at every duty station.
cost_share.method: 5% of the national mean BAH rate for the pay grade and dependency status (DTMO); statutory basis 37 U.S.C. 403(b)(3)(A)(ii) and (B)
cost_share.source: Defense Travel Management Office, 2026 BAH Out-of-Pocket Amounts
cost_share.values_read: E05 with dependents $126 (without $110); O03 with dependents $151 (without $138)
